# Google Cloud — Google for Startups Cloud Program

Start tier: up to $2,000 USD in credits over a year for startups not yet backed by equity funding. Scale tier: year-one Google Cloud and Firebase usage covered with credits up to $100,000, plus 20% of year-two usage covered up to an additional $100,000.

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Start | $2,000 | $2,000 USD in credits* | No partner needed |
| Scale | $100,000 | Google Cloud and Firebase usage covered with credits up to $100,000 | _Not stated by the vendor_ |
| AI-first startups | $350,000 | You can receive up to $350,000 USD in cloud cost coverage | _Not stated by the vendor_ |

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

amount_max is the Scale tier YEAR ONE figure only; year two is separate and percentage-based (see after_credits). The page's headline 'up to $200,000 (up to $350,000 for AI startups) over your first two years' is a two-year sum and is deliberately not used as amount_max. The AI-first figure of $350,000 is published on this page but its detailed terms live on a separate 'Learn more here' page that was not inspected. Company age is worded 'Founded within 5 years of applying to the program (or 10 years for Scale)' — 'founded' is not defined as incorporation, so age_basis is unknown; top-level company_age_max_years uses the Start/general 5-year figure. The page says 'Here are some of the basic requirements', so the eligibility list is explicitly non-exhaustive and partner_gate is left unknown. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
